cost_basis: worst case over the declared alternatives. Not an expectation, because no probability over reference interpretations has been established, and not a human time estimate
reason: no sequence of declared presence questions makes every cell decided. Some admitted worlds differ in a way that asking which objects exist cannot separate, so more looking for objects will not settle this
scope: the declared alternatives and declared presence questions only. An unresolvable verdict means these questions cannot settle it, not that no observation could
